title: 'Are you with the mob or the law?' Kamra asks Mumbai police before comeback show

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Patrick Mahomes is preparing to return for the Kansas City Chiefs after suffering ACL and LCL tears in his left knee last December. Although he has been cleared for full participation, NFL executives remain uncertain about whether he has regained the mobility that makes him dangerous. Kansas City is also dealing with offensive line and defensive changes. Mahomes is expected to start against Denver on September 14.
title: Patrick Mahomes’ mobility concerns grow ahead of crucial post-surgery test

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Back in 2023, bankruptcy documents revealed that Tom Brady and Gisele Bündchen held nearly two million shares in FTX, once valued at around $32 billion. Brady owned more than 1.1 million shares, while Bündchen held 686,000. Their exact investment costs were unknown, but the stakes were considered virtually worthless after FTX collapsed. The former couple had also served as high-profile ambassadors and advisers for the crypto exchange.
title: Tom Brady and Gisele Bündchen linked to $32B FTX collapse over $2M stakes

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Caitlin Clark has expanded her growing off-court profile with a new collection from a major drinkware brand valued at an estimated $4.5 billion. The partnership builds on their collaboration that began in 2025, featuring tumblers and bottles in Clark’s Future design. The Indiana Fever star already boasts major deals with Nike, Gatorade, State Farm and Wilson, highlighting how her influence continues to extend beyond basketball.
title: Caitlin Clark’s $4.5B brand deal adds to her growing global empire

author: MAHIMA SHARMA
description: Germany's far-right AfD party is on the verge of a groundbreaking success in Saxony-Anhalt, with projections indicating they’ve captured 44% of the votes, significantly surpassing the conservative CDU. This marks a historic shift in the landscape of post-war German governance. However, the AfD faces challenges ahead in forming a government due to the lack of a majority. Global reactions have varied, reflecting on this unexpected electoral outcome.
title: Far-right AfD makes historic breakthrough in Germany, wins 44% in state poll

author: SMRITI JAIN
description: Stock market recommendations: CG Power and Industrial Solutions, and Adani Power - these are the top stocks to buy that have been recommended by Motilal Oswal Wealth Management Research Desk for the week starting September 7, 2026:
title: Top stocks to buy: Stock recommendations for September 7 week - check list

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: In August, American employers surprised many by adding 162,000 jobs, a figure well above market predictions. However, the technology sector experienced a downturn, losing 23,000 jobs as advancements in artificial intelligence reshaped the industry. Meanwhile, industrial manufacturing saw an upswing, regenerating 16,000 positions following prior losses. The unemployment rate held firm at 4.
title: Tech jobs shrinking because of AI but chip factories are creating new manufacturing roles

author: SMRITI JAIN
description: The revised arrangement makes the pre-open process more similar to the auction mechanism followed during the Closing Auction Session (CAS). NSE said the objective is to bring the mechanism used for determining the market opening closer to the framework already followed for the closing auction.
title: New stock market pre-open session rules from today: What changes for you?

author: TNN
description: Homeopaths are now practicing modern medicine after receiving pharmacology certificates. Many practitioners lack access to qualified MBBS doctors in their areas. This situation forces locals to seek cheaper and more accessible alternative practitioners. These practitioners often dispense allopathic medicines for various ailments. Experts suggest more rigorous training could utilize their existing skills effectively.
title: Homeopaths turn to allopathy amid job insecurity in Maharashtra

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: Misbah-ul-Haq, the former captain of Pakistan, has voiced his disappointment with the Pakistan Cricket Board's inconsistent policies, particularly regarding the treatment of local versus foreign coaches. He emphasized that knee-jerk reactions under pressure fail to solve issues, and advocated for a thorough evaluation of team performances. Misbah pointed to India's methodical approach to development as an exemplary model for fostering sustained improvement in cricket.
title: ‘Cosmetic surgery’ won’t fix Pakistan: Misbah takes aim at PCB after stepping down

author: RK LAXMI
description: Four pilgrims died when their bus overturned on the Eastern Peripheral Expressway early Monday. The vehicle hit a road divider near the Badagaon cut, causing the fatal accident. Around thirty-two passengers were travelling from Rajasthan towards Badaun when the crash occurred. Rescuers quickly shifted injured passengers to nearby hospitals for medical treatment. Authorities are investigating the circumstances surrounding the serious road crash.
title: 4 killed, over two dozen injured as bus overturns after hitting divider in UP

author: VIVEK DUBEY
title: Video captures moment Amazon cargo plane hurtles off runway, erupts in flames

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Geoffrey Hinton's pioneering AI research at the University of Toronto has led to a flourishing technology ecosystem. This vibrant milieu encourages skilled professionals from around the globe, enhanced by Canada's favorable immigration measures. Presently, Toronto stands as the third leading city worldwide for tech talent, outpacing numerous cities in the US.
title: Godfather of AI backs Canada in tariff war, claims it welcomes immigration, unlike US

author: RATNAKAR MANNE
description: Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty have emerged victorious at the China Masters BWF Super 750 tournament. In a riveting final against He Ji Ting and Ren Xiang Yu, the Indian pair turned the tide after a shaky start. Their adaptability and strategic finesse played a vital role in their triumph, instilling a strong sense of confidence as they prepare to defend their title at the upcoming Asian Games.
title: Satwik-Chirag breach Great Wall, China Masters win boosts Asian Games hopes

author: JYOTIRMOY HALDER
description: Nihal Sarin is excited to represent India at the Chess Olympiad in Samarkand, where India will defend its Open title, but is currently focused on the Global Chess League. The 22-year-old calls the Olympiad a long-time dream. Meanwhile, American Gambits lead the GCL standings after two days, despite Nihal’s individual win over Levon Aronian.
title: ‘Long dream’: Nihal Sarin 'excited' but 'not thinking about' Olympiad title defence

title: Watch: CCTV captures moment Delhi's Satya Niketan building collapses, leaving 6 dead

author: TNN
description: A building collapsed in Satya Niketan, prompting an investigation into its structural integrity. Investigators are examining if illegal construction work contributed to the tragic collapse. The building was over four decades old and housed thirteen registered paying guests. Authorities are also probing potential waterlogging issues that may have weakened the structure. The civic body is reviewing building height violations and recent construction activities.
title: 40 yrs old, 'illegal' work, waterlogged basement: The many holes in Satya Niketan's PG

title: 1929 Oleander Hotel in Louisiana gets new life as Grand Isle Museum

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Meet Bradley Carlisle, a groundbreaking figure as the first professional Santa Claus with Down syndrome. After graduating from a performer school and being inducted into the International Santa Claus Hall of Fame, Carlisle conquered his childhood fears related to Santa. Encouraged by his mother and an association's outreach, he stepped into this beloved role. His journey underlines the significance of inclusivity and spotlights his remarkable abilities.
title: Meet the US’ first professional Santa with Down syndrome

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: An LSU student named Bruce had a chance at a million-dollar reward during a broadcast sponsored by Pat McAfee and Home Depot. Selected randomly from the crowd, he attempted a 33-yard field goal twice but unfortunately missed both shots. This challenge comes on the heels of prior seasons where students successfully claimed large cash prizes along with donations to charity.
title: Pat McAfee puts $6M into GameDay prizes, gives LSU student 2 shots at $1M

author: AMIT KUMAR
description: The sons of former Pakistan captain and Prime Minister Imran Khan have strongly criticised Pakistan Cricket Board (PCB) chairman Mohsin Naqvi after the board was accused of threatening to abandon the Lord’s Test against England. Sulaiman and Kasim Khan also raised serious concerns about their father's health and conditions in prison, claiming that Pakistan authorities are trying to silence him.
title: 'They're clearly hoping to kill him in there': Imran Khan's sons raise serious concerns

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: Pakistan Cricket Board is undertaking a significant rebuilding phase following poor tour performances.  Senior players have been removed from the squad for the final Test match.  Former bowler Shoaib Akhtar believes the board has lost confidence in the current team.  He stressed the need to protect the careers of younger fast bowlers.  The board is now focusing on developing a new generation of players for the future.
title: 'Pakistan on ventilator': Shoaib Akhtar reveals PCB’s 'nothing' expectation

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A Pennsylvania couple, Paul and Cynthia Black, bought 78.3 acres in 2022 with preservation in mind. The property is now permanently protected through a conservation easement, expanding a 236-acre corridor. Their broader conservation efforts across three contiguous projects have eliminated plans for 88 houses and 21 condominiums, preserving farmland, woodland and clean water.
title: Pennsylvania couple saves 78 acres, blocks 109 homes from being built

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Engineers in Texas have made groundbreaking progress by recycling discarded roofing shingles into robust road surfaces. After extensive testing, these innovative materials showed they could match the performance of conventional asphalt, enduring significant traffic wear. The success of this pilot program also spurred the implementation of state-wide regulations that promote the use of recycled shingles in highway construction, leading to both cost savings and conservation of natural resources.
title: Texas highway test shows recycled shingles perform like asphalt

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A pioneering nature restoration firm has acquired Emblehope Moor to embark on a significant rewilding initiative. This visionary endeavor seeks to establish a thriving wildlife haven in northern England, while ensuring investors receive returns on their contributions prior to the land transfer. The project focuses on revitalizing peatlands and eliminating invasive tree species, all while valuing and utilizing local expertise for effective rewilding practices.
title: Britain’s ‘yellowstone’ plan: 7,500 acres bought for £8.5m

author: VIBHA SHARMA
description: Satya Niketan, once a quiet resettlement colony in Delhi, has evolved into a bustling student enclave. Following the university's expansion in 1973, the area saw a sharp rise in demand for student housing. Properties morphed as they expanded beyond original designs without the requisite approvals. This rapid transformation sparks concerns regarding structural integrity and the adequacy of local infrastructure to support the growing population.
title: From resettlement colony to PG hub: How Satya Niketan was stretched beyond its limits
